title: Can LLMs Understand What We Cannot Say? Measuring Multilevel Alignment Through Abortion Stigma Across Cognitive, Interpersonal, and Structural Levels
reasoning: The paper extensively evaluates and benchmarks the influence of religious affiliation (Protestant, Catholic, etc.) and religiosity on LLM outputs regarding abortion stigma. It includes specific experiments and tables (such as Table 21) comparing model representations against human data for different faith groups, making the analysis of religion a core component of the study.
